subject: Rename redisCommand to serverCommand (#174)
reason: The change is a mechanical rename of the internal C struct 'redisCommand' to 'serverCommand': all 340 changed lines in the diff contain the old or new type name, and none alters a string literal, reply, error message, config, protocol byte, or module-API symbol. It is a compile-time refactor with no observable behavior change on any build, so no runtime scenario can distinguish the change from its parent and none is needed.
